notes.title: I am working on a New Game!
notes.notes:
Hello 
I have been working on a new game for a month or so now and I am now showing it off. 

What comes with Room 13:

- an endless hotel with spot the difference gameplay
- 7 different shaders  
- 30 anomalies 
-Realistic art style 

About:
You are inside an endless hotel but there is a way you can escape. Search in the hallways of the hotel and find the changes within them to reach Room 13.
If you find anomalies, turn around!
If you think the room is normal continue to the exit.
To get to Room 13.
Room 13 is a small walking simulator inspired by the backrooms and liminal spaces.

[previewyoutube=z7D5o4N-Nsw;full][/previewyoutube]

Steam page link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2785850/Room_13/



What does it mean for Chapter 3 Of The Paper Trials?

this game isn't going to change any of the plans for the game and I just needed a different project to take a break from developing that.
I Have started the development of Chapter 3, and it is still months away from release.

notes.title: I am working on a New Game!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009908/a6e459e6af52294f32b50b6ece5510beb56db422.jpg[/img]
Hello 
I have been working on a new game for a while now and I am now showing it off this game is going to be a chapter-based arcade horror game with you being able to replay every level to earn an S rank in all of them.

What comes with chapter 1:

-One level that has a normal and expert difficulty 
-A start for the narrative of the world of ink haven
-Two characters to get introduced into the world "The Strange librarian" and "The doctor"
-A ranking system that will add many hours of replay ability
-A unique art style: everything is hand drawn 
-Full Controller support 
-cheat codes for customization of the map 
-free to play 

About:
A first-person horror maze game. Hiding & standing still is Death. Run or you are DEAD. Trapped in a realm of nightmarish mazes with your only hope of survival is to find all of the pages to the mysterious book and ESCAPE!

This is the first chapter in The Paper Trials. survive the first maze. You are not alone. The doctors in there and they are looking for you. Will you survive?

[previewyoutube=DIHu2RysxC4;full][/previewyoutube]

Steam page link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2548330/The_Paper_Trials/
